Telluride by Trailer

Road Book · checked Nov 23, 2026 · not saved yet

⌂ CatalogBeforeD1D2D3Help

Three riding days from Lake City. Best in late September. The calls to make are at the top; the day strips work without a signal.

Using it offline

  • Nothing to download: opening this page with a signal saves it. When the top says ✔ saved for offline, it's on this phone: page, maps, strips, GPX files and the weather.
  • Then open the same address without a signal. Easiest: in Chrome, ⋮ then Add to Home screen (iPhone: Share, then Add to Home Screen).
  • The night before, open it with a signal: that gets the latest version and a fresh forecast for the dates you set below.
  • It stays until you clear the browser's data. Try it once in airplane mode before you leave.

Weather and what to wear

At the hour you'd be at each place. Within 16 days: a forecast. Further out: the last five years.

Go or no-go

Your ticks stay on this device.

As of Nov 23, 2026: not a promise for your ride date.

  • ✖ Closed · Day 2, mile 108

    Beaver Park Road (FR 611) washout

    Closed to everyone by Forest Service order through June 30, 2027; repairs not expected before spring 2027. Our line runs through the closure's section (T41N R12W sec. 3) and past FR 611.2A. If it is still closed, see the way around in day 2.

    GMUG order 02-04-05-26-30 · ☎ Norwood Ranger District 970-327-4261

  • ⚠ Check · Day 3, mile 120-126

    Alpine Road (FR 868) after the Elk Fire

    Closed in July 2026 and orders were still in force Aug 13. The order's page is now gone, and no reopening notice was found. The mapped fire edge is about 0.2 mi from our day 3 line.

    Forest Service alerts · ☎ GMUG headquarters 970-874-6600 (ask for Gunnison)

  • ⚠ Check · Day 3, mile 55-68

    Gold Mountain burn, Owl Creek Pass

    About 9 of these miles are inside the 2026 fire. Side roads (Cow Creek, Middle Fork Cimarron) are closed to May 31, 2027; the pass road itself is not on the closed list. Expect mud and debris after storms.

    GMUG order 02-04-06-26-29 · ☎ Ouray Ranger District 970-240-5300

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 1-25

    Engineer Pass (Alpine Loop)

    Closed for the season Oct 29, 2026. Usually opens in early to mid June (an unofficial estimate) and closes with the first big snow in October.

    Alpine Loop status · ☎ Lake City visitor center 970-944-2527; BLM Gunnison 970-642-4940

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 36-58

    US 550, Red Mountain Pass

    Washed-out shoulder between Ironton and Silverton: one lane, alternating, on Oct 28, 2026. Nothing newer found. Mudslides closed the pass in July 2026.

    CDOT, Oct 28, 2026; live: cotrip.org

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 81-101

    Last Dollar Road

    Listed open on Nov 23, 2026; closed to motor vehicles Dec 1 to May 15.

    San Miguel County · ☎ San Miguel Road & Bridge 970-327-4835

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, mile 68-107

    FR 526, CR H, Ground Hog and Black Mesa roads

    Not named on the closed lists. Dolores district roads are open unless signed, but after the fall 2026 floods the San Juan forest advised against travel on its roads.

    San Juan NF, updated Nov 5, 2026 · ☎ San Juan NF 970-247-4874

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, mile 90

    The way around Beaver Park

    A desk draft: not reviewed, not ridden, and whether each road is open to us wasn't checked. Ask Norwood when you call.

    Forest Service alerts · ☎ Norwood Ranger District 970-327-4261

  • ✖ Closed · Day 2, mile 96

    Groundhog campground store

    Its own site says it closed for good on Nov 15, 2024. Don't count on food, water or fuel. The lake was drained for repairs in 2022; its level now isn't known.

    Groundhog Lake RV Park

  • ✔ No issue found · Day 2, mile 4-64

    CO 145 to Dolores

    Closed by rockfall in the October 2026 storms, since reopened (CDOT, Oct 28).

    CDOT

  • ✔ No issue found · Whole trip

    Fees and permits

    None found for a street-plated motorcycle on these roads. The OHV permit rules around Lake City are written for OHVs.

    Alpine Loop rules

To do

  • 2-3 weeks before: call the Norwood and Ouray ranger districts about the ✖ and ⚠ lines above.
  • The week before: check alpineloop.info, COtrip and the Forest Service alerts; ask for a fresh Road Book check.
  • The night before: weather, fuel, coffee hours; make sure this page is saved on the phone.
  • In the bag: rain layer and warm layer (Engineer is 12,800 ft), tire repair, water, printed strip, cash (The Depot in Dolores may not take cards).

If it goes wrong

  • Emergency 911. Phones don't work on most of the Alpine Loop (BLM); assume no signal on any dirt.
  • Sheriffs: Hinsdale 970-944-2291 · San Juan 970-387-5531 · Ouray 970-325-7272 · San Miguel 970-728-1911.
  • Telluride Regional Medical Center 970-728-3848 (24/7 on the map data) · clinics: Lake City Area Medical Center; Cedar Point Health, Ridgway.
  • Late September sunset is about 7 pm.

Desk-planned; distances can be off by a few tenths. Hours change: call. Not legal advice; the Forest Service's MVUM is the legal document. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors; relief: USGS The National Map; fire perimeters: NIFC.
